relationship_to_v5_protocol: Post-hoc characterization only. The v5 final catalog was opened by the completed frozen evaluation before this protocol was written. This protocol cannot select, promote, replace, or deploy an artifact.

ordinary_supervised_mlp.reproduction: Deterministically regenerated with train_physical_world_model.py defaults; digest and all historical metrics match physical_world_model_evaluation.json.

risk_score: Maximum signed violation margin across forecast clearance, human-motion, geofence, battery, link, emergency-stop, and repair-approval predicates. Positive values indicate predicted violation.

matched_fpr.reference: rules-only false-positive rate on the calibration partition
matched_fpr.selection: For each adjustable method, choose the calibrated-probability threshold with calibration FPR closest to the reference; break ties by lower FNR, then higher threshold.
matched_fpr.threshold_candidates: All unique calibrated probabilities plus one value above the maximum.
matched_fpr.test_role: Report transfer FPR/FNR on the paper test partition without retuning.

simulator_integration.claim: Independent simulator execution only; not actuator-disabled HIL and not physical deployment.

frozen_boundaries: Do not promote any checkpoint from this analysis.
Report failed or unfavorable results without suppression.
